name: Magnetic Tile Surface Defect Dataset
description: Industrial surface defect saliency and segmentation dataset comprising 1,344 images of magnetic tile surfaces used in permanent magnet electric motors. Developed by the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CASIA), encompassing five defect categories (blowholes: 115, cracks: 57, frays: 32, breaks: 85, uneven grinding: 103) and 952 defect-free surfaces with pixel-precise ground truth binary masks.
